description: This file defines the EmployeePictureAPI class, a RESTful API endpoint for managing employee pictures in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and updating employee pictures, validation rules, and metadata annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EmployeePictureAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for employee picture operations such as retrieval and update in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmployeePictureService.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch an employee's picture based on employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring empNumber is accessible.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an employee's picture with the provided attachment data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method, including base64 attachment validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; deletes are not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; deletion validation rules are not provided.
